note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Extra keys (note, followup, manual_prepare, manual_teardown) are for the recorder person; the kit ignores them. Every python command opens its own MSAL interactive sign-in (the token cache is in memory): the owner signs in as labadmin when the browser asks, or exports the app-registration variables in the shell before recording (never in a file). Never show or keep lab.json (real names and ids).
prepare: if (-not $env:DATAVERSE_URL) { throw 'Set $env:DATAVERSE_URL to the lab environment URL in this shell first (the owner does this; it is never written in a file).' }
manual_prepare: Admin center, environment DEV: business units Sales (parent root) and Sales Portugal (parent Sales).
Roles (copy Basic User): Project Requester, Project Approver, PMO Team Member with the Project Request settings from demo.md.
Users: alex.demo to Sales Portugal with Project Requester; sam.demo to Sales Portugal, no direct role.
Teams: owner team PMO Lisbon (role PMO Team Member, member sam.demo), access team PR-0004 deal room (alex.demo, sam.demo), optional Entra group team Sales Approvers.
Records: PR-0001 owned by alex.demo, PR-0002 by PMO Lisbon, PR-0004 shared with the deal room (Read, Write, Append). Export the two GUIDs as MGL_PR0001_ID and MGL_PR0004_ID.

screens.name: role-editor
steps: In the table list find Project Request: Read = Parent: Child Business Unit; Write, Append, Append To = Business Unit
Open the role's Settings (Member's privilege inheritance): 'Direct User (Basic) access level and Team privileges'
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: teams
steps: Make PMO Lisbon (Owner), PR-0004 deal room (Access) and, if created, Sales Approvers (Microsoft Entra Security group) visible together
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu
any real user names (only lab users may appear)

screens.name: verify
prepare: if (-not $env:MGL_PR0001_ID -or -not $env:MGL_PR0004_ID) { throw 'Set $env:MGL_PR0001_ID and $env:MGL_PR0004_ID (record GUIDs from the record URLs) in this shell first (owner).' }
screens.note: export prints its summary on stderr (stdout goes to lab.json). Record whatever Dataverse answers, including a differing row.

screens.name: check-access
steps: Open a private browser window and sign in as alex.demo
Select environment DEV, Apps, open the model-driven app that contains Project Request
Command bar, Check access (the ... menu if collapsed)
Show how access was granted (expected: shared, through the access team)
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

manual_teardown: Remove the share on PR-0004; delete teams PR-0004 deal room, PMO Lisbon (reassign PR-0002 first), Sales Approvers.
Remove roles from alex.demo and sam.demo, delete the three custom roles, move users back to the root business unit.
Disable business unit Sales, then delete Sales Portugal first and Sales second.
needs: users:alex.demo,sam.demo with Dynamics 365 Sales trial licences (already assigned)
